source_text: De prophetia Balaam fratres exposcere maluerunt. Nunc vituperabilis nunc laudabilis: prohibitus a Deo venire persistit mercedis cupidus; tamen verba Dei profert.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning prophecy of-Balaam brothers to-expound preferred. Now blameworthy now praiseworthy: forbidden by God to-come he-persists of-reward greedy; yet words of-God he-brings-forth.
pass_b_english: Brothers asked rather for Balaam’s prophecy. He is now blameworthy, now praiseworthy: [[forbidden to go, he still presses on, greedy for reward >> Bible:Numbers 22:12-21]], yet he utters God’s words.
